summary: No performance concerns. The lite path adds only a handful of bounded git subprocess calls (name-only diffs, ls-files) at open/fix/close — no hot paths, no loops over large sets, no query fanout. mode_run_config is a one-time regex read of harness.yaml. The terra@high fix is a single foreground delegation, reusing the existing launch/reap machinery unchanged.
residual_risks: _lite_manifest / _lite_dirty_product_files each shell out to git 1-2 times; negligible at the human-supervised, small-fix scale this feature targets.
